· RSI 궤적 (60.2→61.6) + 중립 구간 지속 중, 상방 압력 약화 진단
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0061→-0.0088) + 음수 구간 유지 및 악화, 약세 전환 신호 미확인

[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 매수 진입 조건: RSI 70 이하 냉각 후 반등 확인 또는 MACD 골든크로스 발생 시
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($1.43) vs SMA5/20/50($1.42/$1.42/$1.20): above short/mid-term trends, indicating mid-term trend dominance.
· Position vs SMA100/200($1.16/$1.27): above long-term trends, maintaining strong long-term trend.
· 52-week position (20.1%) + current price range in historical low territory.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (60.2→61.6) + continued neutral range, diagnosing weakening upward pressure.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0061→-0.0088) + remaining in negative territory and worsening, no trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $1.42) + band width 12.15% indicating contraction phase.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.38) + confirmed support based on pivot and 5-day low.
· Swing resistance ($1.47) + resistance zone near 5-day high and upper Bollinger Band.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern ($1.45/$1.38 vs $1.68/$1.26): confirming sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.23x) + moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + entry conditions: cooling RSI below 70 followed by rebound confirmation or MACD golden cross occurrence.
